description: This file contains utility functions, class definitions, and helpers for constructing and manipulating nested tensors in PyTorch, including buffer wrapping, shape querying, and tensor view creation.

classes.name: NestedNode
classes.description: A generic tree node structure used to represent nested tensors, which can be either leaf nodes containing a tensor or internal nodes with children.

classes.name: TensorNode
classes.description: A type alias for NestedNode specialized for at::Tensor, representing nested tensor structures.

methods.name: wrap_buffer
methods.description: Wraps a buffer tensor into a nested tensor, with overloads for different metadata inputs.

methods.name: get_buffer
methods.description: Retrieves the buffer tensor from a nested tensor.

methods.name: create_nested_view_tensor
methods.description: Creates a view of a nested tensor sharing storage with the base tensor.

methods.name: NestedTensor_get_sizes
methods.description: Returns sizes of underlying tensors within a nested tensor.

methods.name: NestedTensor_get_max_size
methods.description: Returns the maximum size across all tensors in a nested tensor.

methods.name: NestedTensor_get_max_size_from_size_tensor
methods.description: Computes max size from a size tensor.

methods.name: NestedTensor_get_strides
methods.description: Returns strides of underlying tensors within a nested tensor.

methods.name: check_numel_equals_buffer_size
methods.description: Checks that the number of elements matches between nested tensor and buffer.

methods.name: get_size_for_index
methods.description: Gets size of tensor at a specific index, handling nested or normal tensors.

methods.name: get_stride_for_index
methods.description: Gets stride of tensor at a specific index, handling nested or normal tensors.

methods.name: get_offset_for_index
methods.description: Gets storage offset for tensor at a specific index, handling nested or normal tensors.

methods.name: map_nested_tensor
methods.description: Applies a function over nested tensor structures, returning a wrapped tensor.
